tests.title: Title and introduction without verified remit
supplied_premises: JGA introduces a person with a senior-sounding title.
Actual payroll decision remit and verification basis have not been supplied.
tests.expected_route: Eligibility clarification only after collection route cleared; no completed contribution.
tests.forbidden_inference: An introduction/title proves eligibility, consent or response.

tests.title: Eligible practitioner with no recent case
supplied_premises: Relevant senior payroll remit has a recorded verification basis.
The constructed person permits the intended analysis and supplies substantive operating/priorities input but recalls no recent decision.
tests.expected_route: Use existing no-recent-case Q006 route and Q014; no invented Q007 decision position.
tests.forbidden_inference: No recent case means no usable contribution, or the need is pending/declined.

tests.title: Written input plus a later interview
supplied_premises: One verified eligible person supplies usable report input in writing.
The same person later has an interview under the same participant reference with permission.
tests.expected_route: Two contribution/session records if appropriate, one person; version/mode/coverage preserved.
tests.forbidden_inference: Two modes or contribution records are two distinct practitioners.

tests.title: Member and report overlap in a combined session
supplied_premises: One verified eligible senior payroll person has an actual combined report/member session.
Substantive report-relevant input and both purposes/permissions are established.
tests.expected_route: One participant, report contribution mapped to actual covered questions, one Table conversation event.
tests.forbidden_inference: Two roles become two people or two Table conversations.

tests.title: Commercial buyer without payroll practitioner remit
supplied_premises: A buyer has one actual exploratory conversation covering B01–B06 as relevant.
No qualifying senior employer-side payroll remit or report contribution is established.
tests.expected_route: Buyer commercial record only, with interest distinct from commitment.
tests.forbidden_inference: A paying/intending buyer automatically counts as a practitioner or proves demand.

tests.title: Only older context and declined case detail
supplied_premises: An otherwise eligible person supplies permitted substantive operating input and older context.
They decline recent-case detail; no qualifying recent event is established.
tests.expected_route: Keep older context separately, stop declined request, continue Q014 if they choose.
tests.forbidden_inference: Older context is recent-case evidence or refusal justifies repeated probing.

tests.title: Participation without recording or named release
supplied_premises: A verified eligible person provides actual usable report input with permitted analysis.
They decline recording, named quotations, employer identification and recontact.
tests.expected_route: Manual notes under approved arrangement; preserve permitted analysis and restrictions. No recording, named release or follow-up.
tests.forbidden_inference: General participation authorises every optional use or declining recording blocks all participation.

tests.title: Pilot and repeated Table conversation
supplied_premises: One eligible permissioned pilot provides usable report input with a comparable recorded guide version.
The same person completes two substantive Table feasibility conversations.
tests.expected_route: One distinct report person if actual input/version/comparability qualify; two Table event records; assess remaining four-conversation scope honestly.
tests.forbidden_inference: Pilot automatically counts without usable comparable input, or repeat Table session disappears from event count.
